messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - P1
incident-bot: Service=infra/inference-realtime (us-east-1) · Symptom=GPU queue growth detected (queue=1,200), 95p latency >3.5s, increased 5xx errors. Autoscaler attempted scale up but nodes failed to join.

anna_oncall: On pager. Starting quick triage: autoscaler + ASG events + LT changes.

jordan_sre: Checking cluster-autoscaler and ASG events. CA shows repeated "failed to register instance" with message: "InstanceProfileNotFound" plus intermittent EC2 Throttling (Rate exceeded). Also several nodes rejected by kubelet due to unexpected taints.

lee_infra: I deployed a minor launch-template update at 07:12 to roll AMI -> we may have a tag/instance-profile propagation delay. AWS console shows new instances with AttachRoleStatus=attaching/pending.

anna_oncall: That fits. Jordan, can you list ASG desired vs current and instance states?

jordan_sre: gpu-ml-asg desired=7 current=3, pending instances i-0c1... (AttachPending), i-0d2... (Pending). CA tried 5x then backoff. CA log excerpt:

```
I0315 07:18:02.012] scaleUp: requesting 4 nodes
I0315 07:18:05.234] provider: CreateInstance error: AttachRoleNotReady for i-0c1
I0315 07:18:10.401] scaleUp: aborting attempt, will retry after backoff
```

maya_support: We're getting customer reports: elevated 429s and timeouts on realtime endpoints. Ops page marked "degraded".

patricia_ml: Impact: approx 25% fallback hits, tail latency for critical tenants > SLA for last 12m. Recommend routing A/B tenants to cpu fallback and reducing non-critical traffic.

anna_oncall: @lee_infra can you create a short-lived ASG using the previous LT/version that uses the legacy instance profile so we get capacity immediately?

lee_infra: Spawning a temp-asg with LT version v9 (known-good) and instance profile gpu-legacy-profile. Command run:
```
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-temp-warm --launch-template LaunchTemplateName=gpu-lt,Version=9 --min-size 0 --max-size 6 --desired-capacity 3 --vpc-zone-identifier "subnet-xxx"
```
Setting scale-in protection.

jordan_sre: On K8s side I'll add a nodeSelector/taint for fallback pool and move critical deployment to schedule onto those nodes. Also removed an accidental infra taint on legacy AMI that prevented scheduling (`node-role.kubernetes.io/infra:NoSchedule`).

anna_oncall: @patricia_ml start routing rules: move critical tenants A/B to cpu-inference endpoints; Maya prepare customer comms.

maya_support: Draft ready, sending to Customer A then B. Incident page updated: "mitigating - fallback routing and warm nodes".

jordan_sre: Temp nodes joining now; 3 nodes Registered -> kubelet Ready. Queue dropped from 1200 -> ~380 in 7m. Error rate down to ~12% of baseline.

lee_infra: Reverted LT change and re-applied correct tags for instance profile propagation. Opened AWS support case for expedited attach role propagation on the pending instances.

anna_oncall: Good. Keep temp-asg until autoscaler behaves. Jordan monitor CA logs + ASG events; Lee follow up with AWS support.

jordan_sre: Added watch scripts: `kubectl get nodes --selector=sku=fallback -o wide` and `kubectl logs -n kube-system deployment/cluster-autoscaler --tail=200`. CA started successful scaleUp once attach role finished for subsequent requests.

incident-bot: Handoff scheduled to @lee_infra in 15m. Status=mitigated (fallback nodes active), customer impact reduced.

maya_support: Customer messages sent. Support queue flagged high-priority for affected tenants.

patricia_ml: Telemetry: 95p latency trending back to normal after reroutes and warm nodes. Will run quality checks for CPU fallback outputs.

anna_oncall: Action items recorded in incident doc: 1) maintain temp fallback pool until warm pool PR merged, 2) add IAM attach-role health check as gating signal, 3) improve autoscaler backoff/retry for AttachRoleNotReady, 4) add dedicated alert for AttachRole failures and CA scale-up aborts.

lee_infra: I'll open PR for warm-pool and CFN changes; adding IAM propagation check to our provisioning pipeline.

jordan_sre: Current queue=48, errors ~baseline. I'll monitor for 30m then resolve if stable. :white_check_mark:

anna_oncall: Marking incident mitigated. We'll run a short postmortem tomorrow to assign owners and timelines. Thanks team. :pray:
